description: The file 'LoggingPreferences.cpp' contains implementation of a C++ plugin class 'LoggingPreferences' within the WPEFramework namespace. It manages logging preferences, specifically handling keystroke mask enable/disable settings via IARM bus calls, including initialization, deinitialization, and notifications.

classes.name: LoggingPreferences
classes.description: A plugin class in the WPEFramework namespace responsible for managing logging preferences, especially keystroke masking, via RPC methods and IARM bus communication.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, including IARM initialization.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin and cleans up.

methods.name: DeinitializeIARM
methods.description: Deinitializes the IARM interface, checking for connection status.

methods.name: isKeystrokeMaskEnabled
methods.description: Gets whether keystroke masking is enabled by calling IARM bus and responds with the status.

methods.name: setKeystrokeMaskEnabled
methods.description: Sets the keystroke masking preference via IARM bus call based on input parameter and emits change notification.

methods.name: onKeystrokeMaskEnabledChange
methods.description: Sends a notification when keystroke mask enabled state changes.
